scripts.dev: concurrently -k --success all --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:check"
scripts.dev:check: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "& backend/scripts/wait-health.ps1; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; Write-Host '[wait-health] monitoring until Ctrl+C'; while ($true) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 3600 }"
scripts.dev:frontend: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "& backend/scripts/wait-health.ps1; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; npm --prefix frontend/open-core-reference run dev"
scripts.verify:frontend: npm --prefix frontend/open-core-reference run lint:boundaries && npm --prefix frontend/open-core-reference test && npm --prefix frontend/open-core-reference run build
scripts.verify:public: npm run verify:boundaries && npm run verify:canonical-dto && npm run verify:frontend && npm run verify:backend
scripts.verify:all: npm run verify:public && npm run verify:generated-export
